cards.hook: Before the chat tab: open your sent folder.
cards.body: Find the email you keep rewriting by hand. That is the first AI build, not a new tool. Example (made up): the reply to "Is this in stock?"

cards.hook: Write its steps on paper, in order.
cards.body: One line each. Example: 1. Check the stock sheet. 2. Check the next delivery date. 3. Write the reply with both.

cards.hook: Circle the step that never changes.
cards.body: Example: step 3, the shape of the reply. That step goes to the chat tab first. The checking stays with you for now.

cards.hook: Paste the list, not the wish.
cards.body: Give the chat tab your steps and one real past reply with the customer's name taken out. Check what comes back against what you would have sent.
You build it. See what is included on the About page.
